statement.zh-TW: 能說明借方與貸方只是記帳的左右兩邊，並用會計恆等式說明為什麼每筆分錄的借貸金額相等
statement.en: Explain that debit and credit are simply the left and right sides of the record, and use the accounting equation to explain why every entry’s debits equal its credits

text.zh-TW: 以為「借方」代表借錢、「貸方」代表貸款
text.en: Thinking ‘debit’ means borrowing and ‘credit’ means lending

text.zh-TW: 以為借方一律是增加、貸方一律是減少
text.en: Thinking a debit always means an increase and a credit always a decrease

text.zh-TW: 以為借貸相等是因為每筆交易一定一個科目增加、另一個減少
text.en: Thinking debits equal credits because every transaction must increase one account and decrease another

text.zh-TW: 以為 T 字帳左邊是收入、右邊是支出
text.en: Thinking the left of a T-account is income and the right is spending

statement.zh-TW: 能判斷常見交易（出資、進貨、賒銷、收款、付費用、借款）各要借記、貸記哪些科目，並寫出分錄
statement.en: Decide which accounts to debit and credit for common transactions (capital contribution, purchases, credit sales, collections, paying expenses, borrowing) and write the entry

text.zh-TW: 收到現金時把現金記在貸方
text.en: Crediting cash when cash is received

text.zh-TW: 收回帳款時再貸記一次營業收入
text.en: Crediting revenue a second time when a receivable is collected
Debiting the liability account when borrowing

text.zh-TW: 進貨時就借記營業成本
text.en: Debiting cost of sales at the time of purchase

statement.zh-TW: 能把分錄過帳到 T 字帳並算出餘額，再說出這個餘額出現在哪一張報表的哪一列
statement.en: Post entries to T-accounts, work out the balance, and say on which statement and line that balance appears

text.zh-TW: 把 T 字帳兩邊的合計相加當作餘額
text.en: Adding both sides of a T-account together as the balance

text.zh-TW: 以為餘額一定落在借方
text.en: Thinking the balance always ends up on the debit side

text.zh-TW: 以為收入科目的餘額會直接列在資產負債表上
text.en: Thinking a revenue account’s balance appears directly on the balance sheet

statement.zh-TW: 能說明網站分錄中的「借 存貨」「借 營業成本／貸 存貨」和教材版面「本期進貨」「期末存貨」兩列的對應，並說明盤盈的分錄
statement.en: Explain how the site’s entries ‘debit inventory’ and ‘debit cost of sales / credit inventory’ map to the course layout’s ‘purchases’ and ‘closing inventory’ lines, and explain the entry for a stocktake surplus

text.zh-TW: 以為「本期進貨」「期末存貨」是分錄裡的科目
text.en: Thinking ‘purchases’ and ‘closing inventory’ are accounts used in journal entries

text.zh-TW: 以為進貨時就借記營業成本，本期進貨就是營業成本
text.en: Thinking cost of sales is debited at purchase, so purchases equal cost of sales

text.zh-TW: 以為盤盈要記成營業外收入
text.en: Thinking a stocktake surplus is recorded as non-operating income
